_README: Appointment status for the faculty who appear in the enrollment export.
The export carries no full-time / part-time information, so this file is
the only place it lives. It drives evaluation committee planning: a
full-time instructor needs 3 committee members, a part-time instructor
needs 2, and only full-time faculty may serve.
status  surname, exactly as the export spells it -> "full-time" or
split   for a surname shared by two people. Each entry gives a display
name, a status, and the CRNs that belong to that person. ONE
entry per surname may omit "crns"; it catches every section not
claimed by another entry. Without this, two people collapse into
names   optional full names for display.
Keys starting with an underscore are ignored, so these notes are safe to
keep. Run  python3 refresh_dashboard.py  after editing to bake it in.
